modmenu.summaryTranslation.herzium: Responsive hotbar previews with three selection-order preferences.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.herzium: Choose Vanilla, last-input or lowest-slot priority. Herzium (last input) is the default and changes real slot selection; Vanilla order keeps Vanilla selection. Input sampling is unchanged and no click is ever sent sooner; with the burst options, on by default, a click can wait one tick so it runs with the item of the key pressed before it.
herzium.warning.title: ABOUT HERZIUM
herzium.warning.message: Priority Hotbar previews the selected order on the next rendered frame. Ordinary items can appear in hand without the equip dip; combat items keep Vanilla's transition. Mod Menu offers Vanilla order, Herzium (last input), and Vanilla reversed (lowest slot). Herzium (last input) is the default: among slots with pending clicks the last pressed binding wins, which changes the real selected slot and may change the item used on a server. It is not Vanilla-equivalent; choose Vanilla order in Mod Menu to keep Vanilla selection. Input sampling, normal/remapped click processing and cooldown handling retain their existing paths.
herzium.warning.notice.raw_input_buffer: Raw Input Buffer is installed. Herzium does not change its pipeline or Vanilla Raw Input.
herzium.warning.notice.ixeris: Ixeris is installed. Herzium does not change its pipeline or Vanilla Raw Input.
herzium.warning.notice.inventory_tweaks: KoHs Inventory Tweaks owns Cursor Landing. Herzium never changes Raw Input or cursor placement.
herzium.warning.notice.both_pipelines: Raw Input Buffer and Ixeris are both installed. Their external mouse pipelines overlap; Herzium does not mediate them. Remove one.
herzium.warning.notice.exordium: Exordium is installed. Herzium bypasses its HUD cache, so that part of Exordium is inactive while both mods run.
herzium.warning.tip.0: Herzium removes waiting, not work. It adds no frames.
herzium.warning.tip.1: Vanilla order prefers the highest slot when several slot clicks are pending.
herzium.warning.tip.2: Herzium never speeds up the server's 20 ticks per second.
herzium.warning.tip.3: Alternative orders change the real winning slot, not just its highlight.
herzium.warning.tip.4: Combat items keep Vanilla's complete hand and equip transition.
herzium.warning.tip.5: Fabric API is not required. VSync and frame limits remain Vanilla-owned.
herzium.warning.tip.6: Order is a preference for simultaneous slot inputs, not faster clicking.
herzium.config.title: Herzium · Priority Hotbar
herzium.config.order.label: Order: %s
herzium.config.order.vanilla.description: When several hotbar slots have pending clicks, the highest slot wins. Example: 1 + 9 selects 9.
herzium.config.order.herzium.description: Among slots with pending clicks, the most recently pressed binding wins. Example: 9 then 1 selects 1. Duplicate bindings use the highest slot as a tie-break.
herzium.config.order.vanilla_reversed.de: When several hotbar slots have pending clicks, the lowest slot wins. Example: 1 + 9 selects 1.
herzium.feature.split.description: When one tick holds a hotbar key pressed after a click, that key and every click pressed after it wait for the next tick, so each click uses the item of the last key pressed before it. "Obsidian, use, crystal, use" places the obsidian now and the crystal on the next tick, on top of that obsidian. Every tick still changes the slot at most once, before its clicks, as Vanilla does; nothing is sent early and no click is created or repeated. Off is Herzium 1.10.7.
herzium.feature.strict.description: An attack also keeps the key pressed before it when a use follows in the same tick: "sword, attack, crystal, use" hits with the sword and places the crystal on the next tick. Off keeps Vanilla's "attack, key, use" in one tick, where the attack takes the later key's item and the use is not delayed.
herzium.feature.sync.description: Vanilla sends an offhand swap or a drop before it tells the server which slot the same tick selected, so "totem key, swap" inside one tick swapped the item held before. With this on, the server learns the slot first, as Vanilla does before a use or an attack, and in the Herzium order a key pressed after the swap waits for the next tick.
herzium.feature.hold_guard.description: When a click has to wait one tick for its key, Vanilla saw the button still held and used the old item at once: one extra use with the wrong item, the ghost block of 1.11. With this on, the held button waits together with its click. It only acts in the tick where a click is waiting; holding the button to keep placing or mining is unchanged.
herzium.feature.one_click.description: Two uses or two attacks pressed inside one tick (50 ms) go one per tick instead of both in the same one. Nothing is lost and nothing waits more than one tick. Off by default, and measured: the click moved to the next tick lands on the block the first one just placed. With latency and standing still, Grim's AirLiquidPlace alerted on that click, as it does on a Vanilla double click that falls on two ticks. Leave it off unless a server asks for one placement per tick.
herzium.feature.repeat_filter.descriptio: A hotbar key that stays held makes the keyboard repeat it, and Vanilla counts every repeat as a new press. With the last-input order, a held key took the slot back from the one you tapped after it. With this on, only real presses count for the order.
herzium.feature.mouse_keys.description: Use, attack, swap and drop bound to a keyboard key repeat while the key is held, as text does; a mouse button never repeats. With this on those keys act once per press, like a mouse button. Off by default: repeating an action by holding its key is Vanilla behavior some players rely on.
herzium.feature.preview.description: The hotbar and the hand show the slot of the key you pressed on the next frame, without waiting for the game tick (up to 50 ms). Only drawing: the real selection still happens in the tick and no packet is sent sooner.
herzium.feature.preview_recovery.descrip: If the preview and the game ever disagree about the slot, the preview stops, so the screen never lies. Before 1.12 it stayed off until you changed world, and the hotbar felt slow for the rest of the match. With this on it comes back after 3 seconds.
herzium.feature.swap_preview.description: An offhand swap is drawn at once, in the hands and in the hotbar, instead of when the server answers, your ping later. Only drawing: if the server has not confirmed it in half a second, the screen shows the real items again.
herzium.feature.combat_preview.descripti: Swords, axes, maces, tridents and the other combat items also take the hand at once. Off by default: their equip animation is how Vanilla shows the attack cooldown starting again, and hiding it can make a hit look charged when it is not.
herzium.feature.slot_pop.description: The item of the slot you select makes Vanilla's small bounce, the one an item makes when it arrives in the hotbar. A confirmation, as fast as your frames, that the key was read. Only drawing.
herzium.feature.no_equip_dip.description: Ordinary items appear in the hand at once, without the lowering and raising that hides them for a few frames. Combat items keep that animation unless "Combat items too" is on.
herzium.feature.smooth_indicator.descrip: The attack indicator advances every frame inside the tick instead of jumping once per tick. It never shows more charge than the game would give the hit.
herzium.feature.response_meter.descripti: Shows in the bottom left corner of the HUD how long your last hotbar key took to reach the screen and to reach the game tick, in milliseconds. Measured, never estimated. The same numbers are here below.
herzium.feature.shape_monitor.descriptio: Watches the packets this client sends, whichever mod causes them, for three things a server can tell from Vanilla: a hotbar change after a click of the same tick, the same slot sent twice in a row, and two placements in one tick. It only counts; nothing is changed. The first two must stay at 0: Vanilla never sends them.
herzium.kohs.name: Zymekoh
herzium.kohs.role: KoHs Mod Suite is a one-person studio: every mod and plugin, its code, screens, art and updates, is made by Zymekoh. Tools that make Minecraft PvP sharper and better looking, built for fair play.
herzium.kohs.role_short: Every KoHs mod and plugin, its code, art and updates, made by one person for fair PvP.
herzium.config.vanilla_note: Vanilla behavior; not the default. Input sampling and normal/remapped clicks keep their existing timing. Repeated slot presses retain Vanilla's queue.
herzium.config.alternate_note: This changes real slot selection and can affect which item is used on a server. It is not Vanilla-equivalent; follow the server's mod rules. Sampling and repeated-slot queues keep their existing timing; the burst options can make a click wait one tick, never go sooner.
